files.Title: AeroDB.CompiledQueryPlanner
files.Summary:
Static planner for interface-based compiled queries (Marten-compatible pattern).

For each unique compiled query type, the planner builds a once and caches it. The plan stores:

  • The skeleton with sentinel parameter values.
  • A mapping from SurrealQL parameter keys ($p0, $p1, …) to query property names.
  • Which properties (if any) supply the LIMIT / START values.

At execution time the skeleton is cloned, property values are read from the query instance, parameters are substituted, and the query is executed.

files.Title: AeroDB.CompiledQueryProvider<T>
files.Summary: Query provider for compiled queries — uses pre-parsed SurrealQL from a without re-walking the LINQ expression tree.

files.Title: AeroDB.CompositeProjection

files.Title: AeroDB.ComputedIndexOptions

files.Title: AeroDB.ConcurrencyChecks

files.Title: AeroDB.IBatchedQuery
files.Summary:
A batch of compiled queries that are executed together in a single SurrealDB multi-statement round trip (Marten-compatible pattern).

Usage:

var batch = session.CreateBatchQuery();
var justin = batch.Query(new FindByFirstName { FirstName = "Justin" });
var tamba = batch.Query(new FindByFirstName { FirstName = "Tamba" });
await batch.Execute();
var user1 = await justin;
var user2 = await tamba;

files.Title: AeroDB.IPatchExpression<T>

files.Title: AeroDB.IProjection

files.Title: AeroDB.IProjectionContext

files.Title: AeroDB.IProjectionSideEffect
files.Summary: Marker interface for side effects raised during projection processing.

files.Title: AeroDB.ISessionFactory
files.Summary: A pluggable session factory for creating query and document sessions from a store.

files.Title: AeroDB.ISingleServerMultiTenancy
files.Summary: Fluent interface for configuring a single-server multi-tenancy strategy where each tenant maps to a separate database on the same SurrealDB server.

files.Title: AeroDB.ISoftDeleted

files.Title: AeroDB.ISubscription

files.Title: AeroDB.ITenantOperations

files.Title: AeroDB.ITenantQueryOperations

files.Title: AeroDB.ITenantSliceGroup<TId>

files.Title: AeroDB.ITimeSeriesQuery<T>

files.Title: AeroDB.IUnitOfWork

files.Title: AeroDB.IVersioned

files.Summary: Defines a SurrealDB index (simple, unique, composite, full-text, or vector).

files.Summary: Batch document loading extensions for .

files.Title: AeroDB.Metadata.IDocumentMetadata

files.Title: AeroDB.Metadata.ITypeMetadata

files.Title: AeroDB.OpenTelemetryOptions
files.Summary: Configuration for OpenTelemetry instrumentation of AeroDB operations.

files.Summary: Extension methods on for partial document updates (patching). Equivalent to Marten's Marten.Patching.PatchingExtensions.

files.Title: AeroDB.ProjectionCollection
files.Summary: Fluent projection registration API. Replaces the raw on . Implements for backward compatibility.

files.Title: AeroDB.ProjectionContext
files.Summary: Default implementation of .

files.Title: AeroDB.ProjectionCoordinator
files.Summary: Wraps the in an for automatic lifecycle management. Registered in DI by AddAeroDB().

files.Title: AeroDB.ProjectionLifecycle
files.Summary: Defines when a projection is applied. Inline projections run synchronously during SaveChanges; Async projections are processed by the background daemon; Live projections are computed on-demand at read time.

files.Title: AeroDB.ProjectionOptions
files.Summary: Configuration for event projections. Controls which projections are registered, rebuild options (RebuildOnStartup/RebuildProjectionNames), and projection lifecycle strategies.

files.Title: AeroDB.ProjectionProgress
files.Summary: Tracks the last processed event sequence number for the async daemon, persisted in the mt_projection_progress table to prevent full event replay on restart.

files.Title: AeroDB.ProjectionRebuildProgressCallback
files.Summary: Reports progress during projection rebuilds.

files.Title: AeroDB.ProjectionReentrancyException
files.Summary: Maximum side-effect processing depth to prevent infinite loops.

files.Title: AeroDB.ProjectionShard
files.Summary: A projection shard — one worker that processes events for a specific projection. Each shard has independent progress tracking, health monitoring, and lifecycle.

files.Title: AeroDB.QuerySession
files.Summary: The concrete query session implementing . Provides read-only access to SurrealDB via LINQ, raw SQL, compiled queries, live notifications, and graph traversal.

files.Title: AeroDB.ReadPreference
files.Summary: Controls which endpoint is used for read operations.

files.Title: AeroDB.SchemaDiff.DiffEntry
files.Summary: A single difference between expected and actual schema.

files.Title: AeroDB.SchemaDiff
files.Summary: Compares expected schema (from DocumentMapping) against actual database state. Generated by .

files.Title: AeroDB.SchemaDiffer
files.Summary: Computes schema differences between configured mappings and the live database. Access via store.Advanced.ComputeSchemaDiffAsync().

files.Title: AeroDB.SchemaMode
files.Summary: Controls the SurrealDB table schema mode. Schemaless (Flexible) allows any fields; Schemafull (Strict) enforces a strict field definition.

files.Title: AeroDB.SchemaOptions
files.Summary: Configuration for SurrealDB schema management. Controls auto-create behavior, schema mode (SCHEMAFULL/SCHEMALESS), analyzers, views, and per-type document mappings.

files.Title: AeroDB.ScopeDefinition
files.Summary: SurrealDB DEFINE SCOPE configuration for user signup/signin flows.

files.Title: AeroDB.Search.Analyzer
files.Summary: Pre-defined analyzer names.

files.Title: AeroDB.Search.Distance
files.Summary: Distance functions for vector indexes (HNSW, DISKANN).

files.Title: AeroDB.Search.Filter
files.Summary: Full-text token filters for DEFINE ANALYZER.

files.Title: AeroDB.Search.Tokenizer
files.Summary: Full-text tokenizers for DEFINE ANALYZER.

files.Title: AeroDB.Search
files.Summary: Well-known constants for SurrealDB search configuration. Use these instead of raw strings for type safety and IntelliSense.

files.Title: AeroDB.SessionOptions
files.Summary: Configuration options for creating a document session.

files.Title: AeroDB.SingleStreamProjection<T>
files.Summary: Creates/updates one projected document per event stream. The document identity is derived from the stream ID stored on the first event.

files.Title: AeroDB.SingleStreamProjection<TDoc, TId>
files.Summary: Single-stream projection with a typed stream identity. Supports both Marten-style static Create/Apply convention methods and AeroDB's instance-based Create/Apply/ShouldDelete methods.

files.Title: AeroDB.SnapshotLifecycle
files.Summary: When a snapshot projection should be rebuilt/refreshed. Maps to Marten's SnapshotLifecycle.

files.Title: AeroDB.SnapshotOptions
files.Summary: Configuration for .

files.Title: AeroDB.SnapshotProjection<T>
files.Summary: Self-aggregating projection. The aggregate type T is also the projection. Event handlers are convention-based: Apply(EventType) or When(EventType) methods on the aggregate itself.

files.Title: AeroDB.SnowflakeGenerator
files.Summary: Static helper for generating Snowflake IDs.

files.Title: AeroDB.SoftDeleteExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods for soft-deleting documents in SurrealDB.

files.Title: AeroDB.SortOrder
files.Summary: No-op stub for Marten portability. SurrealDB does not use index sort orders.

files.Title: AeroDB.SpatialExtensions
files.Summary: Entry point for spatial (geo) queries against SurrealDB geometry fields.

files.Title: AeroDB.StaleDataMode
files.Summary: Controls staleness tolerance for QueryForNonStaleData<T>.

files.Title: AeroDB.StoreOptions
files.Summary: The main configuration object for a AeroDB document store. Configures database connection settings, schema generation mode, projections, event sourcing, multi-tenancy, and all other store behaviors.

files.Title: AeroDB.StreamIdentity
files.Summary: Stream identity strategy for event store streams.

files.Title: AeroDB.StreamState
files.Summary: Metadata about an event stream.

files.Title: AeroDB.SubscriptionOptions
files.Summary: Options for configuring event subscriptions. Controls batch size, polling interval, and stream-level filtering.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealArrayFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB array functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealBytesFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB bytes functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealCommandBuilder
files.Summary: Tracks parameterized query values. Each call to returns a unique $pN placeholder string and records the value for later transmission alongside the SurrealQL string via .

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealCryptoFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB crypto functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealDurationFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB duration functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealFunction
files.Summary: Defines a SurrealDB user-defined function (DEFINE FUNCTION).

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealFunctionParameter
files.Summary: Typed parameter definition for a SurrealDB user-defined function.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealQL search and vector functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only. Use MatchTextAsync<T> and for query execution.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealHttpFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB http functions for use in LINQ expressions. WARNING: These functions execute synchronous HTTP requests from within SurrealDB during query evaluation. Each invocation adds network latency. Using them in Where() predicates may cause one HTTP call per evaluated row. Prefer using these in Select() projections where the call count is bounded. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealMetaFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB meta functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealObjectFunctions
files.Summary:
SurrealDB object functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.
Note: object::merge, object::omit, object::pick, object::set are not available in the current SurrealDB version. Add these when a newer version confirms availability.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealRandFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB rand functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealSeriesFunctions
files.Summary: Marker methods for SurrealDB series:: time-series functions. These are never executed — they are intercepted by the LINQ expression visitor and translated to SurrealQL series::* function calls.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealSessionFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB session functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealStringFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB string functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.SurrealTypeFunctions
files.Summary: SurrealDB type conversion and type-check functions for use in LINQ expressions. These methods are NOT callable at runtime — they exist for expression-tree translation only.

files.Title: AeroDB.TenancyScope
files.Summary: No-op stub for Marten portability. SurrealDB does not use tenancy-scoped indexes.

files.Title: AeroDB.TenancyStyle
files.Summary: Defines the multi-tenancy strategy. Single for single-tenant; Conjoined uses a tenant_id field within a single database; DatabasePerTenant routes each tenant to a separate database.

files.Title: AeroDB.TenantIdStyle
files.Summary: Controls whether tenant IDs are treated as case-sensitive or case-insensitive when matching multi-tenanted documents.

files.Title: AeroDB.TimeBucket
files.Summary: Predefined time buckets for calendar-aligned grouping via time::group().

files.Title: AeroDB.TimeSeriesExtensions
files.Summary: Entry point for time-series queries with temporal bucketing and aggregation.

files.Title: AeroDB.TimeUnit
files.Summary: Time units for duration-based bucketing via time::floor().

files.Title: AeroDB.TokenDefinition
files.Summary: SurrealDB DEFINE TOKEN configuration for JWT/HS* token verification.

files.Title: AeroDB.TombstoneEvent
files.Summary: Marker event for gap-filling in event streams. Written by WriteTombstone.

files.Title: AeroDB.TriggerActionBuilder
files.Summary: Fluent builder for SurrealDB DEFINE EVENT trigger action bodies. Supports typed CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, INSERT, and RELATE statements with compile-time-safe field references via expression trees.

files.Title: AeroDB.TriggerCreateStatement<T>
files.Summary: Builder for CREATE statements within a trigger action.

files.Title: AeroDB.TriggerDeleteStatement<T>
files.Summary: Builder for DELETE statements within a trigger action.

files.Title: AeroDB.TriggerRelateStatement
files.Summary: Builder for RELATE statements within a trigger action.

files.Title: AeroDB.TriggerUpdateStatement<T>
files.Summary: Builder for UPDATE statements within a trigger action.

files.Title: AeroDB.UnitOfWork
files.Summary: Tracks pending document operations for a document session. Implements to expose pending changes for inspection.

files.Title: AeroDB.VersionAttribute
files.Summary: Applied to a long property to indicate it is the concurrency version field. Takes precedence over when both are present on the same type.

files.Title: AeroDB.ViewDefinition<T>
files.Summary: Fluent builder for SurrealDB pre-computed/aggregate views (DEFINE TABLE ... AS SELECT ...). Views are materialized, incrementally-updating tables backed by a SELECT query.

files.Title: AeroDB.ViewDefinition
files.Summary: Non-generic base for view definitions. Used by to enable schema-aware routing of views to per-schema databases.

files.Title: AeroDB.ViewGraphSelectBuilder<TSource, TTarget>
files.Summary: Typed graph traversal builder within a view SELECT column. TSource is the view's source entity type. TTarget is the current traversal target type (used by Select). Call Select to close the chain and return to the parent .

files.Title: AeroDB.ViewOptions
files.Summary: Configuration root for SurrealDB pre-computed/aggregate views. Views are created during DocumentStore initialization.

files.Title: AeroDB.ViewSelectBuilder<T>
files.Summary: Fluent builder for view SELECT columns. Supports aggregates (count/sum/min/max/average), column references, graph traversal entries, and raw SurrealQL expressions. Returned from ViewDefinition<T>.Select(cols => ...).

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBEndpoint
files.Summary: AeroDB endpoint backed by SurrealDB message storage. Creates and for message processing.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBEnvelope
files.Summary: SurrealDB record type for Wolverine message envelopes. Maps to wolverine_incoming_envelopes and wolverine_outgoing_envelopes tables. The body is stored as Base64 string (SurrealDB CBOR byte[] round-trip may be unreliable).

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBIntegration
files.Summary: Wolverine extension that integrates AeroDB (SurrealDB) as the message persistence and saga storage provider. Registers codegen sources, persistence frame provider, and the AeroDB transport.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBMessageStore
files.Summary:
SurrealDB (AeroDB) backed implementation of Wolverine's IMessageStore and all sub-interfaces. All operations use SurrealQL RawQuery with parameterized queries. Envelope bodies are stored as Base64 strings for reliable CBOR round-tripping.

Schema initialization now delegates to the AeroDB pipeline via typed POCOs (, etc.) instead of a hardcoded SurrealQL string.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBOutboxedSessionFactory
files.Summary: Factory that creates instances pre-enrolled in Wolverine's outbox. Mirrors the Wolverine.Marten OutboxedSessionFactory pattern.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBQueueListener
files.Summary: Polling listener that claims and dispatches incoming messages from SurrealDB. Uses the AeroDBMessageStore to load globally-owned incoming envelopes, then dispatches them to the provided IReceiver.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBQueueSender
files.Summary: Sends outgoing messages by inserting them into the SurrealDB wolverine_outgoing_envelopes table via AeroDBMessageStore.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBSagaStorage<TId, TSaga>
files.Summary: AeroDB-backed saga storage for Wolverine using SurrealDB as the document store.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBTransport
files.Summary: AeroDB-backed transport for Wolverine using SurrealDB as the message store. Registers the "AeroDB://" protocol scheme and creates AeroDBEndpoint instances.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBTransportOptions
files.Summary: Configuration options for the AeroDB-backed transport. Controls polling behavior and batch sizes for the SurrealDB message queue.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.AeroDBWolverineOptionsEventExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods for configuring AeroDB event forwarding through Wolverine. Event forwarding is automatically wired when sessions are opened via . This method provides additional store-level configuration for event-related options.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.IAeroDBOp
files.Summary: Side effect that executes against a AeroDB document session.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.ScopedDocumentSessionHolder
files.Summary: Scope-local carrier for the outbox-enrolled a handler is using. When a handler falls back to service location, Wolverine's generated code primes this holder so a service-located / resolves to the SAME session enrolled with the active outbox. See GH-3001.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.WolverineEnvelopeSchemas
files.Summary: Registers Wolverine envelope table schemas on during via the hook. This replaces the hardcoded 131-line SchemaScript string in with proper typed POCOs and the AeroDB schema pipeline.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.WolverineOptionsAeroDBExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods for integrating Wolverine with AeroDB (SurrealDB) persistence.

files.Title: AeroDB.WolverineFx.WolverineOptionsSubscriptionExtensions
files.Summary: Extension methods for registering AeroDB event subscriptions with Wolverine.

files.Summary: Extension methods for registering AeroDB-backed ASP.NET Core Identity stores onto an .
